verses.text: The LORD's message came to me:
"Son of man, prophesy and say, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Wail and say, "How terrible that day will be!"
For the day is near, the day of the LORD is near. It will be a day of clouds, a time of doom for the nations.
A sword will come against Egypt, and Cush will be filled with anguish when the dead fall in Egypt, when her wealth is carried off and her foundations are torn down.
Cush, Put, Lud, all the foreign peoples, Libya, and the people of the allied lands will fall by the sword along with Egypt.
This is what the LORD says: Those who support Egypt will fall, and her proud strength will come crashing down. From Migdol to Aswan they will die by the sword inside her, says the Lord GOD.
They will be desolate among ruined countries, and their cities will lie among ruined cities.
Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I set fire to Egypt and all her helpers are crushed.
On that day messengers will go out from me in ships to frighten Cush, which feels so secure. Anguish will grip them on the day of Egypt's doom. Look, it is coming!
This is what the Lord GOD says: I will put an end to the great crowds of Egypt by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.
He and his army, the most ruthless of nations, will be brought in to destroy the land. They will draw their swords against Egypt and fill the land with the dead.
I will dry up the Nile and sell the land to evil men. By the hands of foreigners I will make the land and everything in it a wasteland. I, the LORD, have spoken.
This is what the Lord GOD says: I will destroy the idols and put an end to the images in Memphis. There will no longer be a prince in Egypt, and I will spread fear throughout the land.
I will make Upper Egypt a ruin, set fire to Zoan, and punish Thebes.
I will pour out my fury on Pelusium, the fortress of Egypt, and wipe out the crowds of Thebes.
I will set fire to Egypt. Pelusium will twist in pain. Thebes will be broken through. Memphis will face enemies in broad daylight.
The young men of Heliopolis and Bubastis will die by the sword, and the cities themselves will go into captivity.
At Tahpanhes the day will turn dark when I break Egypt's power there. Her proud strength will come to an end. A cloud will cover her, and her villages will go into captivity.
So I will punish Egypt, and they will know that I am the LORD.'"
On the seventh day of the first month, in the eleventh year, the LORD's message came to me:
"Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt. It has not been bandaged or put in a splint to heal, so that it can become strong enough to hold a sword.
So this is what the Lord GOD says: 'I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt. I will break both his arms, the good arm as well as the broken one, and make the sword fall from his hand.
I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and spread them throughout the countries.
I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon and put my sword in his hand. But I will break Pharaoh's arms, and he will groan in front of the king of Babylon like a dying man.

I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, but Pharaoh's arms will fall limp. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon and he swings it against the land of Egypt.
I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and spread them throughout the countries. Then they will know that I am the LORD.'"
